title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (abstract page)
note: Abstract page, v1 of 4 Nov 2026, cs.AI and cs.LG, the only version; CC BY 4.0. A trained LLM agent analyses events in notices, weather alerts and schedules, then forecasts the horizon in one pass or in event-defined segments with review and selective refinement. Says it is state of the art in most evaluation scenarios on several load data sets. Links code at github.com/zhjai/ElecLoad.

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (full text)
note: Setup. All series hourly. Horizons: 24 h from 168 h of history, and 96 h from 96 h. In-domain: GEFCom2014 (96 h only), Nord, PJM and SPP (both), LCL and iFlex (24 h only). Out-of-domain: AEMO (96 h), ERCOT (24 h). 1,800 train, 300 validation, 600 in-domain test, 235 out-of-domain cases. PJM: 112 day-ahead and 28 four-day test cases. Metrics WAPE (primary) and NRMSE, averaged over cases.

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (full text)
note: Data and splits (App. A). PJM: metered native load from Data Miner 2 plus EIA-930 balancing-area demand via PUDL, with NWS alerts and PJM emergency notices as events. PJM origins: train to 2022-12-10, validation 2023-01-01 to 2024-11-06, test 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-18; SPP test 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-14. Windows are selected for coverage of entities, quarters and event counts, not evenly spaced.

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (full text)
note: Table 2 headline. Against 14 baselines over 22 metric comparisons ElecLoad is first in 13, second in 6, top two in all 18 in-domain ones, and second to fourth in the 4 out-of-domain ones. GEFCom2014 96 h: WAPE 6.68 and NRMSE 8.42 against MemCast 8.18 and 10.35, stated as 18.3% and 18.6% lower. GEFCom2014 test cases are mostly synthetic: 170 of 200 have events written into the target.

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (full text)
note: Table 2, PJM and SPP WAPE (%). PJM 24 h: ElecLoad 3.13, TimesFM-3 3.43, Chronos-2 3.61, LightGBM 4.89, ARIMAX 7.01. PJM 96 h: ElecLoad 6.03, TimesFM-3 6.11, MemCast 6.32, Chronos-2 6.90, LightGBM 7.07, ARIMAX 10.09. SPP 24 h: ElecLoad 2.36, Chronos-2 2.64, TimesFM-3 2.66. SPP 96 h: MemCast 3.59, ElecLoad 3.63, Chronos-2 4.30.

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (full text)
note: Table 2, out-of-domain WAPE (%). ERCOT 24 h: TimesFM-3 3.99, Chronos-2 4.28, ElecLoad 4.33. AEMO 96 h: TimeReasoner 12.61, MemCast 12.78, ElecLoad 13.49, Chronos-2 13.99. So on systems not used in training the agent does not beat the zero-shot foundation models on ERCOT and trails two LLM baselines on AEMO.

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (full text)
note: Ablations and paired test. PJM 24 h WAPE: full 3.13, direct-only 3.48, no event text 3.51, no covariates 3.79. With multiple events on PJM: full 3.69 against direct-only 4.31. Paired WAPE difference full minus direct-only, 95% intervals: GEFCom2014 -1.14 [-1.31, -0.98], PJM -0.35 [-0.58, -0.12], LCL -0.97 [-1.95, +0.07]. Mean tokens per PJM case 15.3k against 7.0k direct-only.

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (full text)
note: Model and baselines. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, all parameters updated (supervised then reinforcement learning, twice), teacher DeepSeek-v4-flash, four H100 GPUs. Baselines run on the same cases through the inputs each supports; Chronos-2 and TimesFM-3 settings are not itemised. Temperature forecasts at the origin are stated for GEFCom2014 only. No pre-registration is mentioned.

title: GitHub - zhjai/ElecLoad
note: Repository linked from the paper: one commit dated 2 Nov 2026, no releases, no licence file in the listing. Holds the four-role runtime, prompts, inference and evaluation scripts and fine-tuning entry points. README: data sets, trained checkpoints and paper results are not included, the snapshot is not verified as the one behind the paper's numbers, and the demo runs scripted responses.

title: ElecLoad/docs/release.md
note: Release notes, version 0.3.0. Ships runtime, prompts, inference, evaluation, fine-tuning entry points, loss functions and tests. Does not ship data sets, trained weights, checkpoints or distributed training. States the checks cover implementation mechanics only and are not a reproduction of the paper's results, and that no rights to third-party assets are granted.

title: ElecLoad/docs/data.md
note: Data interface. A case needs rendered load history, covariate and event evidence, exact future timestamps and an evidence manifest; future labels are kept apart. The example case is synthetic. Data set construction, the selected splits and the paper's final predictions are not distributed; users must obtain source data from each provider and build matching inputs.

title: GitHub - zhjai/ano-repo
note: A second repository by the same account with the same code and an earlier README (12 commits, Oct 25 to Nov 2, 2026; found by the search and named by the research call). Same statement: no data sets, trained weights or result files, and the snapshot is not identified as the revision behind the paper's numbers. Not linked from the paper.

title: Qwen3.5-4B model card
note: Card of the base model ElecLoad fine-tunes: 4B-parameter causal language model with a vision encoder, public weights. The fetched card text shows no licence line and no file dates; its citation gives February 2026. The research call's source entry for the raw README lists Apache-2.0 in the front matter. Base model only; no ElecLoad checkpoint is published.

title: tulipa762/electricity_load_diagrams (research source, not fetched)
note: Returned by the research call as the nearest Hugging Face record; a generic electricity data set unrelated to this paper. Recorded as a negative: the research task found no ElecLoad model or data set record on Hugging Face. Not fetched and not cited.

title: you-search: ElecLoad replication or discussion
note: One open-web search, LinkedIn excluded. Four results: the arXiv abstract and full-text pages and the author's second repository. No replication, critique, citing paper, blog post or model record.

title: you-research (standard): primary sources for and against the ElecLoad claim
note: One research task, LinkedIn excluded. Its sources were the paper's full text, the two author repositories, the Qwen3.5-4B card and one unrelated Hugging Face data set. It reported no independent replication, critique or pre-registration, and no ElecLoad checkpoint or data record. Its answer text is not used as evidence; each source has its own row.
